headline: Mid Penn Bancorp Misses Third-Quarter Profit and Revenue Expectations
summary: Mid Penn Bancorp reported third-quarter financial results that fell short of consensus estimates, missing per-share earnings targets by $0.01 alongside a revenue shortfall.
why: US community and regional banks provide early indications of net interest margin pressures, loan growth rates, and credit provision trends.

impacts.name: Mid Penn Bancorp, Inc.
impacts.why: Missing both top- and bottom-line analyst projections exerts downward pressure on the lender's stock price.
